newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse ends slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse ends slightly higher.

text.p: Casablanca stocks ended slightly higher on Thursday, with the main index up 0.08 percent lifted by large capitalisation firms, including Wafabank, a broker said.
The all-share index closed 434.15 points, up from 433.81 points on Wednesday.
One of the the liquid stocks, Wafabank rose 11 dirhams to close at 530 dirhams.
Morocco's largest private group, ONA Group, remained stable at 490 dirhams for the second consecutive day.
With stakes in more than 100 firms, ONA has a market capitalisation of 8.2 billion dirhams, analysts said.
Societe Nationale d'Investissement, the country's second conglomerate was unchanged at 558 dirhams.
One of the liquid stocks, Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur lost two dirhams to close at 393 dirhams.
Traded volume on the official market was 14.7 million dirhams against 48.9 million dirhams on Wednesday.
